messages.author: f16139c83b3d0c31
messages.subject: Permission denied to download cmdstan
parts:
Hello,

I tried to download the latest version of cmdstan with a Matlab inference.
However, if I try to download cmdstan, it stops after some time and shows me that I do not have the permission.
Then I tried to clone cmdstan via the terminal, which worked. However, when I try using it, I received the same error message: permission denied.
It also always shows me that it cannot find the following folder:

find: stan/src/stan/lang: No such file or directory


Does somebody know how to solve it? Might it be a problem related to my computer (which is unlikely though, as I am the admin;so I should have the rights).


Any advice is appreciated.

Thank you.


Nadescha

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: Permission denied to download cmdstan
parts:
Hi Nadescha,

It looks like GitHub has changed their interface again.

You'll want to follow these instructions: https://github.com/stan-dev/cmdstan#installation

Go to the release page and download the zip or tar.gz file WITH THE SIZE next to it. (they used to have green links, but now they don't)

You won't be able to do that directly from the develop branch. If you want to use the develop branch, you must follow these directions: https://github.com/stan-dev/cmdstan#installation-using-git


Daniel
